subject: GCP co-sell Partner manager roundtable — Acme Health opportunity triage
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Singh <psingh@gcp-partner.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell Partner manager roundtable — Acme Health opportunity triage

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the intro to Jordan at Acme Health last week. They surfaced multiple potential pilots across imaging and claims automation; before we escalate to a dedicated AE/SE cadence I wanted to align our partner managers and PMs to triage the joint pipeline so we can agree on next best actions and a co-sell owner.

Proposed agenda (30–40 min):
- Quick account context + current engagement state (Jordan)
- Joint prioritization criteria (cost-to-serve, technical blockers, contract timing)
- Field/SE validation needs and sequencing
- Action items: who owns intro to procurement, POC scope, marketplace listing readiness

I've attached a short workbook to capture candidate opportunities and a prioritization rubric — please review and let me know availability for a roundtable this week or early next.

Attachments: GCP_Joint_Opps_Workbook.xlsx (spreadsheet), MA_Prioritization_Rubric.pdf (1-page)

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Principal Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform
From: Priya Singh <psingh@gcp-partner.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan White <jwhite@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Apr 20, 2027 at 11:28 AM -07:00
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell Partner manager roundtable — Acme Health opportunity triage

Thanks Ava — this is great. Jordan and I reviewed the workbook and have sketched initial notes on two prioritized pilots (Claims OCR + Clinical QA). Jordan can share an internal doc that outlines the compliance and data flow constraints.

I can join a roundtable on Thu (Apr 22) between 10:00–11:00 PT or Fri morning. I'll also invite our lifecycle SE (Maya Rao) and the marketplace listing specialist (GCP Marketplace Enablement) on the call — they'd like to confirm listing requirements and any billing/contract items before we push to procurement.

Quick ask: can you add a short column in the workbook for "data residency / compliance status" and drop Jordan's contact details so we can loop the right people?

Attaching a brief Acme technical summary Jordan shared (Acme_Technical_Summary.pdf) and a link to the GCP listing readiness checklist for reference.

Attachments: Acme_Technical_Summary.pdf
Links: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_ExampleDriveLink

Best,
Priya Singh
Partner Manager, Strategic Partners | Google Cloud
psingh@gcp-partner.com

Subject: Re: GCP co-sell Partner manager roundtable — Acme Health opportunity triage

Thanks — Thu 10:00–11:00 PT works for me. A couple of quick notes from the product/PM side:

- Prioritization rubric looks sensible; attached a short internal version with thresholds that map to Dedicated vs Hosted recommendations (MA_Prioritization_Rubric.pdf).
- For Claims OCR pilot: we need confirmatory data samples to evaluate tokenization and cost estimates; can the Acme team share a representative redacted sample ahead of the call?
- Recommend we add Field Eng (SE) block in the workbook for "expected SE effort" (hrs), and flag any dependencies on internal infra (S3 paths, VPC peering).

I'll be prepared to share a rough cost delta between Hosted API vs Dedicated for the pilot during the roundtable.

Karthik
Director, Product — Serving & Ops | Redwood Inference

Perfect — locking in Thu Apr 22, 10:00–10:40 PT. Ava, can you send a calendar invite and include a Google Meet link? Please load the workbook with the extra columns Priya/Karthik requested and drop the Acme redacted sample link (if available).

Agenda (final):
1) Quick intros + account state (Jordan) — 6 mins
2) Prioritization rubric & recommended owner (Karthik) — 8 mins
3) SE validation checklist + marketplace requirements (Priya + Maya) — 10 mins
4) Next steps: procurement path, POC scope, listing timeline (Ava/Laura) — 10 mins

I'll own the follow-up doc and the action tracker. Sergio — can you prep a one-slide note on commercial levers (promo credits, pilot pricing) we can offer to accelerate procurement?

Thanks all — see you on the call.

Laura Bennett
Head of Field Partnerships | Redwood Inference
